notes.bukhari:1502: Both full own fields supply Anas bringing Abdullah ibn Abi Talha with the purpose of tahnik and observing the instrument and branding of zakat camels. Retain the actual purpose without asserting that tahnik was performed in the unprinted continuation. The explicit parenthetic definition of tahnik is lexical explanation and remains context; the prefatory multistep route is separately retained. Preserve the actual observation and zakat-camel object.
notes.bukhari:1503: Both full fields supply the one-sa dates-or-barley instruction, all enslaved/free/male/female/small/large Muslim categories and the before-departing-for-prayer deadline. Preserve every quantity, alternative and scope qualification. The parenthetic Eid term identifies the prayer governing the deadline and remains material scope. The parenthetic sadaqa-fitr label only repeats the already explicit fitr-zakat category and is lexical context, unlike a field where that category is otherwise absent. Keep the prefatory route outside the actual report and retain Ibn Umar attribution.
notes.bukhari:1505: Both complete fields supply Abu Said's actual first-person community practice of giving one sa of barley. Admit under his own reported voice, without manufacturing a direct Prophetic instruction, a fitr label or a timing condition from neighboring occurrences. The multistep preceding chain remains source context.
notes.bukhari:1506: Both complete fields supply Abu Said's actual fitr practice and the complete own list of one-sa alternatives: grain or wheat, barley, dates, paneer and zabib. Preserve every printed alternative and quantity without harmonizing a sibling. The parenthetic dried-grapes-or-figs explanation defines the already named zabib and remains lexical context; its source wording is not silently corrected or promoted into another independent tax-item report. The multistep route is context, with the final actual reporting predicate retained.
notes.bukhari:1507: Both full fields supply the Prophet's one-sa dates-or-barley instruction, followed by Ibn Umar's distinct report that people later equated it to two mudd of wheat. Preserve the two ordered voices/components and all actual equivalence/temporal language. The half-sa parenthesis specifies the equivalent measure of the actual two-mudd amount and remains a source-qualified quantity. Do not relabel the later people's determination as Prophetic speech or omit either amount. Separate the prefatory multistep route.
